name: Sölderhof
beschreibung: The Sölderhof is located in a quiet district of Tirol, surrounded by meadows and forests. The holiday apartment is traditionally furnished and offers a cozy atmosphere with wooden furniture and alpine character. Guests can expect a fully equipped kitchen, a spacious living room, and a balcony with mountain views. The surrounding area is ideal for hikes and walks in the natural surroundings of Tirol.
